stages.prompt: Register the reviewable video as an immutable draft with scripts/publish_to_studio.py <content> <video> --status draft. Follow studio/README.md.
Fetch http://localhost:8789/api/results and confirm the correct current draft/delivery shows, with a caption for finals. Do not claim visibility from the file alone.
Ask the user to review the draft in Studio. Wait for their decision.
Only on explicit editorial approval, run scripts/update_studio_status.py <content> <delivery-id> review|approved|archived. Never mark approved on your own.
